body:
## Fix

F1. Advance deck-context cancellation generation on every world transition, including leaving Story. A delayed Story save read can no longer replace Free Play context after navigation.
F2. Add deterministic component regression delaying Story reads until Free Play is mounted.

## Validation

V1. Component regression reproduced stale Story context before fix; green after fix.
V2. Parent reran complete editor-context suite: 10 tests passed. Worker AppShell suite: 43 tests; boundary/data-cy suite: 87 tests passed.
V3. Parent reviewed and reran isolated real-Chromium harness: 1 passed. Production AppShell executed two delayed Story reads after navigation; probe stayed free-play with zero Story banners.
V4. Typecheck: 0 errors, 4 existing Svelte warnings. Changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff check passed. Parent reviewed token lifecycle against sibling collection cancellation behavior.

## Limits

L1. Chromium harness executes production AppShell with controlled saves/gameplay and a probe replacing Deck Editor rendering. Full production selected-content/bootstrap smoke remains blocked by existing ASSET_RECOVERY_REQUIRED fixture state; no recovery guard bypassed.
L2. Full local browser/headless suites not run. Harness/logs retained locally outside commit; tracked component regression provides reproducible CI coverage. CI remains separate.
title: fix(shell): ignore stale story deck context reads
